internalEvidence: The publisher-hosted English rulebook was rendered at PDF/printed page 9. Its First Player section gives the jazziest-player criterion and clockwise order, and the next section gives the opening hand sizes. Bebop, Big Shot, character boards and bounty cards match inventory BGG 283642. SHA-256: 4b45f793013f6512b859e27a563ced95d622eb61aab88e9db5c1419617bafa35. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The manual does not define “jazziest” or provide a tie procedure.
